notes.title: Our second game, Once Upon A Tile is now released!
notes.notes:
In a world long forgotten or yet to be discovered, heroes travel twisted paths along hidden roads to defeat an ancient evil they do not quite understand.

In this unique rogue-lite dungeon puzzle game, you do not control the hero directly - instead, you build a dungeon filled with traps, monsters and other challenges, while your hero always takes the shortest path to the newly revealed tiles. Beware, for this may not be the smartest path!

You will need all your strategic tricks and tactical planning to survive and win every encounter.

Are you ready to face destiny itself in [b]Once Upon A Tile?[/b]

Then check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465730/Once_Upon_A_Tile/

notes.title: Resurrecting the missing achievements
notes.notes:
Welcome, fellow Liches.

Cruel minions and machinations have prevented all achievements from being accessible. Also, greedy goblins have set the Bargainer Of Souls achievement to the wrong number - it is 100.000 souls you need to satisfy that hunger, not only 10.000 souls a mere budding necromancer would be happy with.

Also, the Big Hunger will now trigger correctly in all instances - as soon as three souls are harvested at the same time, no matter whether you time your soul cleansers correctly or use an otherwordly power, you will unlock that achievement.

Also, you can no longer reset your achievements. Because who would want this, right?
